Reviewed W05 head `43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d`, frozen base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. The preserved external review is `20261108T071144Z-worker08-independent-worker05-full188-payload138`, YAML SHA256 `bdde7d4101546e0e43f0752e4587c4d0c3a0fb43f887d82eee2d869edd5c06b0`. All 188 case-decision hashes and all 138 selected payload hashes were independently rebound to the published core; the sealed scientific review remains needs_curation. This comment records bounded follow-up before author correction, not approval or application.

**W05-MAT-004:** Extend the product-alias repair to Fish peptone (Fluka), which conflicts with Bacto’s evidenced mammalian product scope. Preserve the exact text/source/history; do not infer a Fluka product, move counts or decide every other generic meat/mixture alias.

- `MATERIALS-C1193-bacto-aliases`: `data/ingredients/mapped/Bacto_Peptone.yaml`, before `864e86820c578ff82b2b32e075c6fb428e704907f78a250c2733b06a70d8e655`, proposed `90d4b4f04e9619f91b8a36af0ea737ce6b43cc6b291b5939854f57f94dd56896`; [exact published payload](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-05/correction-1193-v1/materials/proposed-v2/Bacto_Peptone.yaml).

`Bacto_Peptone.yaml` still carries `synonyms/27: Fish peptone (Fluka)` as CATALOG_VARIANT although plain Fish peptone is already rejected. The captured [Bacto211677 manufacturer specification](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/211677) identifies mammalian protein sources; exact capture SHA256 `ecfed6455cdbdde1d10f6ff236227bb1a0e5b09bc319d0bd4d9a61e0ebc2d9d6`. This adds one exact unresolved token to the existing product-boundary scope, not a new product assignment.

 Preserve all original captures, history, known source/form/role and supported-versus-withheld holds. Use existing guarded proposal validation and independent review; no new code, test, schema, threshold, owner-selection rule, merge, corpus publication or approval transfer is authorized by this finding.

<!-- mim-fingerprints:w05-external-w05-mat-004 -->

The final integration dependency scan confirms that the proposed generic `Peptone.yaml` identity correction must be coupled to its component consumers. The frozen baseline has 19 incoming `MICRO:0000178` component claims; the proposed W02 MRSsi base contributes one additional claim. These are 20 distinct claims, not 20 approved target migrations.

The source-specific disposition is:

- Eight generic-reference migration candidates: `Glucose_Peptone-yeast_Extract[1]`, `Marine_agar_2216[0]`, `PYGS[0]`, `Peptone-yeast_Extract-glucose[0]`, `Peptone_Beef_Extract_Yeast_Extract[0]`, `Peptone_Yeast_Extract[0]`, `Yeast_Extract_Peptone[1]`, and new `togo_m2491_mrssi_base[8]`. The literal source evidence supports generic peptone; it does not establish Bacto, animal origin, digest method or a supplier. Retarget only after the exact final generic owner and consumer are reviewed together.
- Ten unresolved source-identity claims: `Fastidious_Anaerobe_Broth_With_Meat_Granules[1]`, `PY-cellobiose[0]`, `PY-fructose[0]`, `PY-glucose-rumen_Fluid[0]`, `PY-maltose[0]`, `PY-pectin[0]`, `PYEG[0]`, `PYG-002_Tween_80[0]`, `PYG[0]`, `PYG_Rumen_Fluid[0]`. The inherited edges depend on abbreviations or research interpretation. Recover the source identity, or independently review withdrawal of the unsupported resolving identifier to `UNMAPPED` while retaining the literal component and provenance. A hold note must not leave a now-misleading Bacto-resolving identifier in place.
- Retain the source-specific `GYPS[2]` Bacto reference: its original publication p.1622 explicitly specifies Bacto-peptone (Difco). Do not globally replace this reference with generic peptone.
- The current combined Marine Broth proposal already withdraws `Marine_Broth_2216[0]` to `UNMAPPED`; preserve its nominal-formula scope and existing product/lot limits.

The actual native counterfactual is important: changing generic Peptone alone produces zero component-partonomy errors, because the Bacto owner still represents `MICRO:0000178`. Structural green therefore cannot authorize these source referents. This follows MAPPING_SEMANTICS §6: the CURIE denotes the part identity, not a unique document.

Compose overlapping corrections on one final payload: Fastidious also has a cooked-meat withdrawal; PY-glucose-rumen and PYG_Rumen also have rumen withdrawals under #1204. Preserve every preimage, quantity, source assertion and history; no global identifier replacement, owner merging, or approval transfer. The broader source/role/export holds remain.

Evidence is pinned in `preflight/final-component-dependency-plan-v1/minimal-couplings-28.json` and its complete 435-claim replay. The explicit accounting cutoff is 2026-11-08T07:59:05Z; later accepted worker heads must be rebound and re-enumerated before application. #710 is retained as historical semantic-review context, not an open implementation tracker.

The sealed origin addendum verifies existing authentic child proposals for the three rumen consumers, the cooked-meat consumers, and the other represented source cases. Twelve peptone consumers lack a source proposal: five conditional generic retargets and seven ambiguous claims needing evidence or a reviewed identifier withdrawal. The coordinator selects the existing-constructor route: W05 may add authentic dependent `edit_existing_owner` proposals bound to each actual child path and before hash, causally linked to its real generic-peptone case. This causal linkage must not pretend that the child recipe was observed in the shard, and does not itself settle any scientific identity. Existing child origins must be composed rather than duplicated.

A separate direct guarded curation phase is also natively supported, but is not being inserted into an already frozen campaign source/publication checkpoint. No owner changes have been applied. All twenty peptone dispositions and the three overlapping consumer repairs require exact final composition and independent review.

Dependency plan manifest SHA256 `95cfc48d9fd943d9fca75c09c787b9e83521bb052e9c4909b3ad984b7539956e` (98members); authentic-origin/route addendum manifest `6e0df3e4513973fbc63277e17e80f078c6c2d3518039d2e7a90e99113e1f7a29` (28members). Both were rehashed by the coordinator. The addendum explicitly bridges current W01 da45d5a5 UW and W06 1d62a408 PYGS payloads; these are mechanical origin bridges, not new whole-owner approvals.

The independent primary-source and skeptical review of all20 dependent peptone claims is complete. Its bounded outcomes remain eight conditional generic references, ten unresolved aggregate identities requiring withdrawal of unsupported resolving IDs, one source-specific Bacto reference to retain, and the existing Marine withdrawal to preserve. Final child payloads still require independent composition review; these are not whole-owner or export approvals.

A new confirmed source-attribution finding, `PEPTONE-SOURCE-001`, affects `Fastidious_Anaerobe_Broth_With_Meat_Granules.yaml` (authentic preimage `aa56347529508fd0c082571cfd39540c6ac3205ba587c992594015c1e881c6a5`). Its active component assertion attributes the preparation to LabM/Neogen. The original Falsen2005 paper (DOI10.1099/ijs.0.63327-0), inspected through an archived full-paper mirror and matched publisher metadata, attributes FAB to Oxoid. The separately mentioned Anaerobe Systems PYG fermentation broth is not a FAB formulation source. No publisher PDF or historical Oxoid catalogue formula is claimed recovered.

In the genuine dependent successor, withdraw the unsupported peptone resolving ID to UNMAPPED while retaining the inherited literal component and historical provenance. Explicitly qualify the LabM/Neogen comparator as unselected for this source; append truthful source-applicability evidence/history without rewriting original research. Compose with the existing meat-granule withdrawal on the same exact beforeimage. Do not infer an Oxoid catalogue number, replace all components from a comparator, delete starch/glucose, invent quantities, or claim peptone is absent. Other unverified component assertions remain held.

Evidence packet: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/workers/w03/worktree/.temp/peptone-consumer-independent-v1/`; HANDOFF SHA256 `3733050169d1406798da748f4df5168015ea164bdc2cfe58afd86f09d4ae23aa`, MANIFEST `f7df69ec006bf1bc2c344d12404c39385e04e8db2bc7050ce0c216cc610e52c2` (220 members rehashed by coordinator). Finding `ambiguous/confirmed-findings.json` SHA256 `09aa2526a78eff13e6e4821fff95e0f3972b7ab5c64e0116aa132788ef235793`; original-paper extraction `ambiguous/original-source-read-7.json` SHA256 `1a5c9515cb2e7502156700531711ce93d73d80be14506f37f8cded81f0798eca`, p854 source passage. Exact target/owner/case routing is in `machine-ledger.json` and `route-and-composition-v2.json`. This supplements #1176 and the existing #1193 meat-granule work before correction; no duplicate issue or scientific approval is implied.
